messages:
Elaine (CS): FYI Omnify just reported a repeatable issue where their /embeddings route returns vectors that don't match the index snapshot they shipped. They see older vectors for recent docs. Repro steps below.

Omnify Ops (customer): repro steps we used:
1) index doc A v1 -> embed_id 12345
2) update doc A -> reindex -> expected embed_id 67890
3) query by id returns vector for 12345, not 67890

Omnify Ops (customer): we tried restarting worker, cache flush, and a full reindex. Still returns stale vector. Only happens for ~12% of docs, seems non-deterministic.

Elaine (CS): attaching minimal curl repro (they included full request/response in convo):

```bash
# step 1 - index original
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/embeddings/index -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"id":"doc-A","text":"first version"}'
# step 2 - update
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/embeddings/index -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"id":"doc-A","text":"updated version"}'
# step 3 - fetch by id
curl -X GET https://api.redwood.com/embeddings/index/doc-A -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```

Omnify Ops (customer): curl response shows vector metadata timestamp 2026-08-11T13:42:10Z but content matches earlier text. We saved request/response JSON to s3://omnify-support/1962/trace.json (internal only).

Miguel (Eng): thanks for the clear repro. Quick questions: 1) Does Omnify use Redwood hosted index or Dedicated? 2) Any proxy or batching layer on their side? 3) Can we get a full export of the index manifest and any reindex job IDs?

Elaine (CS): Omnify is on Dedicated (dedicated-east-2), single-zone. They use our SDK with client-side batching at 200ms. I asked them to upload the index manifest and reindex job logs to the s3 path above.

Aria (PM): blocking question for roadmap prioritization: how many customers on Dedicated could hit this? If this is a class of reindex/consistency bug we should consider P0 for next sprint. Customer revenue-risk flagged by CS: medium-high (they're in pilot + active ingestion).

Miguel (Eng): initial hypothesis: a cache invalidation race between prefix KV cache and index write acknowledgment. If client-side batching collapsed updates, server may have applied earlier shard-level snapshot after a later reindex. Need logs from dedicated node and the shard commit sequence numbers. Can CS ask Omnify to temporarily disable client-side batching as a test?

Elaine (CS): asked them to flip batching off and re-run repro. Omnify replied they can test thursday. I also requested node logs and the reindex job ID.

DeployBot: Incident ticket created: RED-INC-2026-5879. Linked to thread.

Miguel (Eng): next steps for eng intake: 1) get reindex job ID + node logs 2) reproduce in staging by simulating dedicated shard commit timing + batching behavior 3) instrument commit sequence numbers in index service and add extra guard on read path if commit mismatch detected -> serve fallback or force fresh read.

Aria (PM): scope negotiation: if this needs a code change (guard + instrumentation) estimate 3 dev days + 2 QA days. If it's config tuning (disable cache on reindex window) maybe 1 dev day. Prioritize as P1 until we have reproduction without batching.

Elaine (CS): Omnify confirmed they'll test disabling batching on Thursday and will share logs. I'll update ticket RED-INC-2026-5879 with results and tag you all. :thumbsup:

Miguel (Eng): thanks. If Omnify can't reproduce without batching, we'll need their staging snapshot or a full export. Please ask for DB export and index manifests.

Omnify Ops (customer): thanks team. We'll run tests Thursday PST. We'll also grant temporary read access to s3 path for redwood-eng@omnify (details in support ticket).

Elaine (CS): tagging follow-ups: @Miguel (Eng) can you confirm any quick instrumentation we can add to Dedicated without a rollout? Even a temporary log flag would help.

Miguel (Eng): yes — I can add a debug flag on the index read path to surface commit sequence numbers and cache hit reason. I can push that to the dedicated infra as a config flip (no full rollout). Need ops assist for deployment window.

Aria (PM): summary for backlog: create ticket in product backlog tracking: (a) root-cause analysis (eng) (b) short-term mitigation (config) (c) long-term fix (guard + tests). Assign priority P1, link RED-INC-2026-5879, and target initial RCA in 5 working days.

Elaine (CS): will add backlog ticket and mark customer as impacted in the ticket. Will update thread after Thursday tests.

DeployBot: Reminder: on-call window for dedicated-east-2 ops is 2026-08-12 02:00-06:00 UTC.

Miguel (Eng): noted. I'll prepare debug flag and coordinate with ops for a short flip if we get repro.

Elaine (CS): thanks all — closing loop for now.
